notes.title: Blackout' Massive update!
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting. 
The New ‘Blackout’. Since everything in this game was completely changed and you could experience almost brand new game. 
If there’s any bug or inconvenient details detected, please report via email. I will revise and update ASAP.
Thank you.

Features

1.Add Goal Verification System.
2.Add story (apply interaction, time pop-up, add text).
3.Add scene.
4.4K resolution support.
5.Add new space.
6.Surround support.
7.New and Simple Interaction Systems.

Improvements

1.Change the main menu.
2.Changing and modifying interaction systems.
3.Modify sound volume.
4.Modify FOV distance.
5.Change intro.
6.Change ending.
7.Reduced loading time.
8.Reduced capacity with full capacity compression.
9.Texture optimization.
10.Cross hair icon design and size change.
11.Chinese and Japanese font changes.
12.Light optimization.
13.Adding Sound and Liquid for Easy Progression.
14.Number 11 Scene Mirror optimization.
15.Modify a little house atmosphere.
16.Removing and changing unnecessary objects at the level.
17.Edit scene run events.
18.High intensity flashlight.

Fixed

1.Fixed a bug where players and objects overlap.
2.Fixed the frame break phenomenon.
3.Main menu button malfunction bug fix.
4.Number 5-1 Scene Bug Fixes.
5.Number 7 Scene Bug Fixes.
6.Fixed a bug that caused the player to fall under the floor.
7.Pistol bug fix.
8.Fixed a bug where players moved up to furniture.
9.Fixed front door bug.
10.Fixed car bug.
11.More bug fixes.
12.Fixed the phenomenon that sounds repeatedly when loading.
13.Number13 Scene Bug Fixes.

With this update, the specification has been improved one step. Optimized as much as possible.
